{{Quote|Ilyamo is a tall human with dark hair and dark eyes. I'll show you a holo.|[[Angela]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:DGI">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Disappearances: Gathering Information|Corellia}}</ref>}}
'''Ilyamo''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who lived on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|We live in Coronet City. Ilyamo wanted to go hiking and the best hiking is around here. Their group disappeared 2 days ago.|Angela, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:DGI" />}}
By the time of the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Ilyamo lived in [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet City]] with his wife [[Angela]].<ref name="SWG:DGI" />

[[File:Angela-ThreatOfTheConqueror.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Angela displaying a holo of her missing husband]]
In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> Ilyamo and Angela went to [[Doaba Guerfel/Legends|Doaba Guerfel]] because Ilyamo wanted to go hiking. Ilyamo joined a group who went hiking with the ranger [[Myron Beech]] in the [[Nomad Mountains|Thaos Mountains]].<ref name="SWG:DGI" /> However, the group was captured by psychotic [[cave-dwellers]],<ref name="SWG:DR" /> an anti-government and criminal group.<ref name="SWG:DFR">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Disappearances: Final Reckoning|Corellia}}</ref> [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Talte]] of the [[Corellian Security Force]] therefore hired a spacer to investigate the disappearances of the hikers.<ref name="SWG:DGI" /> The spacer finally managed to find the [[Psychotic cave-dwellers' cave|cave]] where the hostages were kept.<ref name="SWG:DFtC">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Disappearances: Finding the Culprits|Corellia}}</ref> During the assault of the cave, the spacer met Ilyamo who advised to be careful of the cave-dweller leader [[Raynod Menar]]. Ilyamo and the other hostages were eventually freed.<ref name="SWG:DFR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Ilyamo was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:DR" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Ilyamo was added to the game with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 28 Notes for April 26, 2006|Publish 28]]," on [[April 26]], [[2006]].<ref name="SonyForumsCite-What's On Deck! Publish 28 Update Notes, April 26th">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/board/message?board.id=Announcements&message.id=3077&jump=true|text=What's On Deck! Publish 28 Update Notes, April 26th}}</ref>
